# NeotixHQ

> An AI-focused studio exploring practical applications of AI and emerging technologies, and turning selected ideas into working products.

NeotixHQ is a brand operated by [NuCielo ICT B.V.](https://www.nucielo.io/), a Netherlands-registered company.

[Meridian — AI History Explorer](https://meridian.neotixhq.com/) is a NeotixHQ product for exploring, searching, reading, analyzing, and exporting AI conversation history. Processing happens locally in the browser by default.

Our experience also spans AI strategy, solution architecture, cloud and data platforms, and collaboration with organizations applying emerging technology.

## Pages

- [Home](https://neotixhq.com/): Studio vision, exploration, Meridian, collaboration, identity, and contact.
